name: aurora-sandbox-pi
description: The pinned Pi coding agent of the sandbox image (P5-HARN, D-361). The version must match PINNED_VERSION in services/aurora-supervisor/src/adapters/pi/mod.rs; the lockfile pins the whole tree and the image installs it with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`. Pi needs Node.js 22.19 or newer (the image's nodejs).
